title: Gate 5 attempts 4 and 5 -- BOTH PASSED, card-driven, with the accepted profile
driven_from: the card in the browser: Preview -> Dry-run -> Real Go, one instance, waypoints untouched between dry-run and Real Go

attempt_4.caveat: No independent position trace -- the capture window expired before the run started.

profile_identity_PROVEN.note: The card sent the full accepted profile to the mower on both runs. This is the gap LUBA_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE existed to close and it is now closed in fact, not on paper.

key_findings: Gate 5 passed twice. Both runs completed both segments from the card with the accepted profile, zero errors, zero reverse-recovery, and no overshoot (0 samples past a waypoint in the independent trace).
The 0.15 m tolerance is vindicated: the worst landing was 0.1449 m. At the previous 0.08 m that segment would have FAILED.
🔑 The BLE TimeoutError is INTERMITTENT, not turn-magnitude-driven. Attempt 5 demanded turns of 93.5 and 82.9 deg -- both LARGER than the 80.6 deg that timed out on attempt 3 -- and both completed.

🔑 Turn rate per pulse varies 2.6x for IDENTICAL 1500 ms commands: 30.46, 22.17, 57.63 deg (20.3, 14.8, 38.4 deg/s). The executor tracked this, revising degrees_per_second from the 37 default to observed 20.3 then 17.5, while the actual jumped to 38.4.

⚠️ Attempt 5 consumed the ENTIRE turn budget: turn_commands_sent 4 of max 4. Combined with the 2.6x rate variance, a marginally worse sequence would have hit turn_phase_incomplete. This is a fragility, not a pass with margin.

🔑 BLE write latency was markedly degraded on attempt 5 yet did not time out: 15 refresh writes median 540 ms, max 861 ms; stop confirmations 1175, 1819, 402, 628 ms against a 77-230 ms norm. This places the TimeoutError as the TAIL of a latency distribution we can now observe, rather than a discrete unexplained fault.
outstanding: Segment 2 passed/stop_reason not captured for either attempt (JSON truncated in transport). Position evidence is unambiguous and real_segments_executed is 2 with ready_for_multi_segment true, but the literal field was not read.
The BLE timeout remains unfixed. It is now characterised (latency tail) rather than mysterious.
Turn budget has no margin at ~93 deg. Larger turns are not safe on this profile.

conditions.gate: armed immediately before each run, disarmed immediately after, verified each time
